title: Export B2B Website Building for Manufacturers
description: Website building for manufacturers that export: product, specification and company pages built from your own documents, for overseas buyers to evaluate.
lead: We turn your product catalog, specifications and company facts into a website that overseas buyers can read, compare and act on.

sections.title: Who this is for
sections.intro: Manufacturers selling industrial products abroad who already have a catalog, specification sheets or PDFs, but no website a buyer can evaluate on their own.
items: You sell to distributors, contractors or procurement teams outside your home market.
Your product information lives in brochures, PDFs, spreadsheets or your sales team's inbox.
Buyers keep asking pre-sale questions that a clear product page could answer.
You want every product fact on the site to come from your own documents.

sections.title: What we build
sections.intro: We build corporate websites for export manufacturers; the scope, including pages, languages, hosting and ongoing support, is agreed for each project, so send us an inquiry describing what you need.

sections.title: How we work
sections.intro: Each step ends with something you can check before the next one starts.

steps.title: Collect your materials
steps.text: Catalogs, specification sheets, certificates you are allowed to publish, photos and any existing website content.

steps.title: Structure products and specifications
steps.text: Agree product categories, the fields each product page carries and how specification tables read. Gaps and conflicting figures go back to you to resolve.

steps.title: Draft and approve
steps.text: Pages are drafted from your materials. You check and approve every product fact before anything is published.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Publish the approved pages, then confirm that they load, link to each other and can be crawled.

steps.title: Agree next steps
steps.text: Walk through the live pages with you and agree what changes next. Any ongoing support is agreed per project.

sections.title: What we don't promise
items: We do not promise search rankings, traffic levels or a number of inquiries. Search engines and AI assistants decide independently how they show any page.
We do not invent specifications, certifications, customer names or figures. Product facts on your site come from your documents and are approved by you.
We do not show another company's website on this page without that company's written permission.
